metadata.question: Does nitrogen dioxide concentration in Wuhan city, China decrease during February 10-25, 2020 compared to January 1-20, 2020?

data.raw_code: The question is about nitrogen dioxide (NO2) concentration in Wuhan, China during two time periods: - February 10-25, 2020 (during COVID-19 lockdown) - January 1-20, 2020 (before lockdown) I need to: 1. Use Sentinel-5P NO2 data 2. Define Wuhan geometry 3. Compare NO2 levels between the two periods 4. Check for data availability and valid pixels 5. Determine if there was a decrease For NO2 data, I should use: - Collection: COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2 - Band: NO2_column_number_density I'll calculate the mean NO2 for each period and compare them. Potential issues: - Data availability (C1) - Cloud/quality masking (C2) - Invalid calculations (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const wuhan = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [114.0, 30.8], [114.6, 30.8], [114.6, 30.4], [114.0, 30.4] ]); const period1 = ['2020-01-01', '2020-01-20']; // Before lockdown const period2 = ['2020-02-10', '2020-02-25']; // During lockdown // 2. Data Acquisition const no2Col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .select('NO2_column_number_density'); const col1 = no2Col.filterDate(period1[0], period1[1]).filterBounds(wuhan); const col2 = no2Col.filterDate(period2[0], period2[1]).filterBounds(wuhan); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Jan 1-20 Images: ${size1}, Feb 10-25 Images: ${size2}`); // Check for empty collections if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Create mean composites const mean1 = col1.mean(); const mean2 = col2.mean(); // 3. Check valid pixels const count1 = mean1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: wuhan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); const count2 = mean2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: wuhan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); console.log(`Jan valid pixels: ${count1}, Feb valid pixels: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculate mean NO2 concentrations const no2_1 = mean1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: wuhan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); const no2_2 = mean2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: wuhan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); console.log(`Jan NO2: ${no2_1.toFixed(6)}, Feb NO2: ${no2_2.toFixed(6)}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (no2_1 === null || no2_2 === null || isNaN(no2_1) || isNaN(no2_2)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (no2_2 < no2_1) { console.log(`Decrease: ${((no2_1 - no2_2) / no2_1 * 100).toFixed(1)}%`); console.log("A"); } else { console.log(`Change: ${((no2_2 - no2_1) / no2_1 * 100).toFixed(1)}%`); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
